long_biography.plain_text:
Michael Holland developed Dublin’s Fitzwilliam hotel for international business travellers, with interiors by Terence Conran’s company. He and his business partner Brendan Gilmore had met while working at an accountancy firm. Their earlier hotel purchases included the Royal Dublin and Cork’s Metropole, where they added a leisure centre.

Holland sold inbound tour operator Irish Welcome Tours in 2017, one of numerous business transactions beyond his hotel interests. When making acquisitions, he looks for businesses that complement existing operations and bring in management talent. He advocates preparing well before a sale and personally directing negotiations, supported by specialist legal and financial advisers.
